raw_response: {"diagnosis": "27 txn_ids were re-delivered with record_version=2 (4841 rows vs 4814 distinct txn_id), and silver_transactions does not dedupe, so both versions are kept. The fix keeps only the latest version per txn_id, and applies the POSTED filter after that, so a version 2 that is REVERSED cannot be replaced by a stale POSTED version 1.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED'"}}
